subject: Initial discovery & demo — coordination with engineering/procurement/security
message_1_headers:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Perez <alex.perez@pegasus.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Initial discovery & demo — coordination with engineering/procurement/security
message_1_body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the call last week — pleased to kick off the evaluation with Pegasus. We typically run a 45-minute initial discovery + demo with two goals: (1) understand your latency/cost/SLA constraints and key ADL use cases, and (2) show a short, focused demo of the Redwood runtime and routing capabilities so your engineers can ask detailed questions.

To make the session productive, can you include your engineering lead and whoever owns procurement/security? Suggested attendees from our side: myself (AE) and Ben Carter (SE) — I’ve cc’d Ben and Camila (our solutions SE) for scheduling.

Proposed slots (US/PST):
- Tue Aug 13, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Aug 14, 11:00–11:45am
- Thu Aug 14, 3:00–3:45pm

If those don’t work, tell me two times that do and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a short discovery agenda and the latest MSA draft for your procurement team to scan ahead of time.

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: discovery_agenda.md (text, 1 page)
Attachment: Pegasus_MSA_v2.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

Subject: Re: Initial discovery & demo — coordination with engineering/procurement/security
message_2_body:
Hi Marissa — thanks for the options and the materials. I’ll loop in the folks on my side: Samir (eng lead), procurement, and security.

Samir — can you make one of these? We’re in PDT. If not, we can push to next week.

I can do Tue Aug 13 at 10:00 but procurement may prefer Wed. Procurement: any constraints about having the MSA reviewed before the demo?

Alex
VP Product, Pegasus Manufacturing
alex.perez@pegasus.com
message_3_headers:

Date: 2026-08-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery & demo — coordination with engineering/procurement/security
message_3_body:
Thanks Alex — appreciate the quick response.

Samir — hi, I’m Marissa (AE) and Ben (cc) is our Senior SE who will lead the demo portion. Short note on agenda again: 15m discovery (requirements, latency/throughput, data/segmentation concerns), 25–30m demo (runtime, routing, failover, simple eval), 5–10m next steps (POC scope & timelines).

If procurement wants to read the MSA before the call that’s fine — we’re happy to collect comments via DocuSign or a Redline PDF afterwards.

If Tue 10am works for Samir we’ll lock it. If procurement prefers Wed Aug 14, we can move to 11am Wed. Please confirm your preference and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short attachment.

—
Marissa
Attachment: discovery_agenda.md

Also include your pricing/contact for purchasing so we can loop in finance if needed.

Thanks,

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210

Quick note on technical focus areas we’ll cover (so Samir & eng team can prep):
- Expected traffic, p50/p95 latency targets, peak seq lengths
- Data isolation and VPC options
- Fallback policies and routing to lower-cost models for burst events
